Name: OBSOLETE Overgrown Flowery Backpack Fix
Author: CrypticCorvuss
Description:
[b][i][u][size=3]UPDATE:[/size][/u][/i][/b] This is basically already included in the original mod now but I hate seeing things taken down so I'm leaving it up anyways.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16408]Vintage Interface v2 Bigger Backpack Fix[/url], I decided to make an equivalent mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url] to make it look a bit nicer with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] without items being out of the boxes. I was originally just going to download the fix and have it not match but still be pretty and aligned properly, but then I realized I could just make a fix myself. Hopefully anyone who uses the same interface and backpack mods will appreciate this!

To install, first install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1845]Bigger Backpack[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url], then extract the zip into your mods folder the same way, allowing files to be overwritten. For general help installing mods, see the [url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Getting Started Guide[/url] over on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url], a wonderful site that helps the community a ton.

This was shockingly easy, so if anyone has other UI replacers that they use that don't have compatibility with the backpack mod, let me know and I'll see what I can do! Otherwise, this will probably the only mod I ever upload.

All credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83494008]36maraluna[/url], the author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]. They did all the work, I just scooted some boxes around. Should they find this to be using their work in a way they don't feel comfortable with, I'll happily remove this mod ASAP.
